verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own fine-tuning docs say "you keep the resulting weights" (fireworks-ai-docs-62), and training data uses the standard OpenAI SFT format with no conversion (fireworks-ai-docs-57, fireworks-ai-docs-1), which points toward portable, owned artifacts. The REST API also manages models and datasets (fireworks-ai-docs-69), but no documented export or download flow is shown. Missing for 10: documented export/download of fine-tuned weights and their file format, export of uploaded datasets and of batch/inference logs and account data, an account-wide "export everything" path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
